paper_title: OMNIGUARD An Efficient Approach for AI Safety Moderation Across   Modalities
caption: Accuracy of detecting harmful prompts in a few-shot setting. As few-shot examples are provided, quickly achieves near-perfect accuracy, despite the attacks being quite different from its training data (e.g. without any few-shot examples, 's accuracy is close to 50% ). In contrast, the guard model baselines improve their accuracy slowly in a few-shot setting, despite sometimes having seen similar code attacks in their training data. Accuracies are averaged over 50 random sets of few-shot examples; error bars show the standard error of the mean.
model_annotation: The plot titled “Code Attack: Python List” illustrates accuracy values for detecting harmful prompts as a function of the number of few-shot examples, with multiple model lines shown together. The x-axis is labeled “Number of Few-Shot Examples,” uses a linear scale, and spans from 0 to 5 with integer tick marks. The y-axis is labeled “Accuracy,” uses a linear scale, and shows values roughly from the mid-40s up to the high-90s, with labeled ticks at 50, 60, 70, 80, and 90. A black solid line with circular markers (OmniGuard) rises from about 50 at 0 examples to about 89–90 at 1, then increases to roughly 94 at 2, about 95–96 at 3, and ends around 96–97 at 5. A blue solid line with circular markers and vertical error bars (AegisGuard (P)) starts near 52 at 0, increases to about 77 at 1, is around 75 at 2, drops to roughly 63 at 3, and ends near 53 at 5. A red solid line with square markers and vertical error bars (AegisGuard (D)) begins around 64–65 at 0, declines to about 53 at 1, increases slightly to about 55 at 2, and then drops to about 50 at 3 (no red point is shown at 5). A green solid line with circular markers and small vertical error bars (LlamaGuard 1) stays near 50 at 0 and 1, is around 51 at 2, returns to about 50 at 3, and declines to roughly 46 at 5. An orange solid line with square markers and small vertical error bars (LlamaGuard 2) is about 86–87 at 0 and 1, increases to roughly 90 at 2, is around 91 at 3, and ends near 91–92 at 5. A purple solid line with circular markers (DuoGuard) starts near 70 at 0, drops to about 50 at 1, and remains at approximately 50 at 2, 3, and 5.
